notes.title: Flip-Out! 0.4.0 Bugfix and Content Patch
notes.content:
Flip-Out! 0.4.0 includes some key changes that will make gameplay feel better, fix critical bugs, and guide the player's experience.  We've been hard at work implementing new technologies and improving player experience on our first table, The Curse of Crab Cay.  This patch includes greatly improved flipper physics behavior, new voice lines that will help players achieve goals, full controller support, and some important bug fixes.

Patch Notes 0.4.0


 Improved flipper mechanics
 Controller support added
 Input rebinding improvements
 Fixed bug with bug reporting menu that would cause the game to stay paused after report had been submitted or cancelled
 Shot marker lighting is no longer rendered above the ball
 Improvements made to menu navigation
 Powerup timers added for relevant powerups
 Added voice lines.  Some voice lines have been added to guide the player toward goals


Players can expect more patches in Q1 of 2022 that will wrap up development of The Curse of Crab Cay and a playtest of our next table sometime near the beginning of Q2!

notes.title: 0.3.0 Release - Bugfixes, key bindings, experimental gamepad support
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36517728/84fce17b4579308ab41901dc4880bd81e4f7219a.png

Flip-Out! 0.3.0 was just released!  We've been working on internal features to improve the gameplay experience and add to the game's features, which means that players now have the ability to rebind their keys for all inputs besides movement inputs.  It also means that gamepads are now supported (experimentally)!  If you are a gamepad user, we'd love to hear your feedback on how the gamepad gameplay feels and behaves.  There were also a few bugs in the game preventing the normal gameplay loop from progressing and they have now been fixed.  

Development of our internal systems has been progressing rapidly, enabling us to improve performance and speed up development of future tables.  We are currently designing our next table and we hope to be able to start showing off that table very soon.  For now, we ask any players that encounter issues or bugs to leave us a message on the Steam Community forums.  That's it for now!  Enjoy the new patch!

Patch notes:

 Drop targets fixed
 Pufferfish target fixed
 Nudge function fixed
 Forward nudge added
 Bug that caused a new ball to fail to spawn after a ball was lost has been resolved
 Paddle movement should feel smoother now
 Input rebinding now available

notes.title: Flip-Out! 0.2.0 Release
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36517728/84fce17b4579308ab41901dc4880bd81e4f7219a.png

Flip-Out! has reached its first major development milestone with the completion of the basic pinball code for our first table, the Curse of Crab Cay.  There will still be some adjustments and additions to the table, but the basic flow of the pinball state machine is now in-place.  Going forward, we'll be focusing on improving performance, refining physics interactions on the table, adding more complexity to scoring opportunities, and visual and audio enhancements.

We're very excited for the future of Flip-Out!  We've built a solid framework from which to build pinball games with as many twists as we want.  We're looking for player feedback on the build we've released today.  You can provide that feedback in the Steam community forums or in our Discord server which you can access from the button on the main menu screen.

0.2.0 Changelog

  Complete pinball gameplay loop
  Shot marker behavior now works properly (Shoot the blinky things!)
  Powerups integrated with target progression
  Skill shot added
  Added 2 new targets to the table
  Volume on menu items adjusted
  Improved reliability of the skull cave ramp shot
  FIXED: Issue that could cause the ball to become stuck after hitting one of the shell targets
  FIXED: Balls will no longer spawn with fireball texture if ball is lost while fireball powerup is active.
  FIXED: Balls will no longer get stuck if shot into a barrel target once the lid is broken
